Nnoɔma a ɛdi Kristo ba anim
1 # 1 Te 4.13-17 Nso yɛsrɛ mo, anuanom, sɛ yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo ba ne yɛn ano a wɔbɛboa aba ne nkyɛn no ho deɛ, 2mommma wɔnnnane mo adwene ntɛm, na wɔnntu mo bo honhom anaa asɛm anaa nwoma a wɔse ɛfiri yɛn nkyɛn no ho, sɛ ebia Awurade da no anya adu. 3#1 Ti 4.1; 1 Yoh 2.18; 4.3 Mommma obiara nnnaadaa mo biribiara fam, ɛfiri sɛ ɛremma, gye sɛ ɔwaeɛ a wɔbɛwaeɛ no aba ansa, na wɔayi onipa a ɔnni mmara so no adi, ɔsɛeɛ ba no. 4#Dan 11.36 Deɛ ɔsɔre na ɔma ne ho so tia deɛ wɔfrɛ no Onyankopɔn anaa wɔsom nyinaa, ma ɔno ara kɔtena Nyankopɔn asɔredan mu de ne ho kyerɛ sɛ ɔno ne Onyankopɔn.
Ɔsɛeɛ a wɔbɛsɛe mmaratofoɔ
5Monkae sɛ mewɔ mo nkyɛn no, mekaa mo yeinom anaa? 6Na afei, deɛ ɛsi kwan no, monim sɛ wɔbɛyi no adi ne berɛ mu. 7#Aso 20.29 Na mmarato ahuntasɛm no anya reyɛ adwuma, nanso gye sɛ wɔayi deɛ ɔda so si kwan no afiri ntam ansa. 8#Yes 11.4; Adi 19.15; 19.20 Na ɛno ansa na wɔbɛyi deɛ ɔnni mmara biara no adie, deɛ Awurade de n’anomu home bɛkum no na ɔde ne ba no pue bɛyi no hɔ koraa no.
Bɔne a ɛyɛ hu
9 # Mat 24.24; Adi 13.11-13 Ɔno nso na ne ba no, ɔba no Satan adwumayɛ soɔ, atorɔ tumi ne nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ ne ahodwirideɛ nyinaa mu, 10#2 Ko 2.15; 4.3 ne deɛ ɛntene nnaadaa nyinaa mu, wɔn a wɔyera no mu, ɛsiane sɛ wɔannye nokorɛ dɔ na wɔde agye wɔn nkwa no. 11#Rom 1.28; 2 Ti 4.4 Yei nti, Onyankopɔn soma nnaadaa a emu yɛ den aba wɔn mu ama wɔagye atorɔ adi, 12na wɔabu wɔn a wɔannye nokorɛ annie na mmom wɔn ani asɔ deɛ ɛntene no nyinaa atɛn.
Aseda
13 # 2 Te 1.3; Efe 1.4 Na yɛn deɛ, mo nti ɛsɛ sɛ yɛda Onyankopɔn ase daa, anuanom a Awurade dɔ mo, ɛfiri sɛ Onyankopɔn firi mfitiaseɛ ayi mo kɔ nkwagyeɛ mu, honhom ahoteɛ ne nokorɛ gyidie mu. 14Emu na ɔnam yɛn asɛmpa no so afrɛ mo aba, na moanya yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo animuonyam.
Afotuo ne mpaebɔ
15 # 2 Te 3.6 Enti afei, anuanom, monnyina pintinn, na monkura atetesɛm a yɛnam asɛm anaa yɛn nwoma so kyerɛkyerɛɛ mo no mu. 16Na ɔno yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo ne yɛn Agya Nyankopɔn a ɔdɔ yɛn na wama yɛn daa awerɛkyekyerɛ ne anidasoɔ pa adom mu no, 17ɔnkyekyere mo werɛ, na ɔnhyɛ mo den asɛm ne adwuma pa nyinaa mu.

pageProps.chapterText:
Nso yɛsrɛ mo, anuanom, sɛ yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo ba ne yɛn ano a wɔbɛboa aba ne nkyɛn no ho deɛ, mommma wɔnnnane mo adwene ntɛm, na wɔnntu mo bo honhom anaa asɛm anaa nwoma a wɔse ɛfiri yɛn nkyɛn no ho, sɛ ebia Awurade da no anya adu. Mommma obiara nnnaadaa mo biribiara fam, ɛfiri sɛ ɛremma, gye sɛ ɔwaeɛ a wɔbɛwaeɛ no aba ansa, na wɔayi onipa a ɔnni mmara so no adi, ɔsɛeɛ ba no. Deɛ ɔsɔre na ɔma ne ho so tia deɛ wɔfrɛ no Onyankopɔn anaa wɔsom nyinaa, ma ɔno ara kɔtena Nyankopɔn asɔredan mu de ne ho kyerɛ sɛ ɔno ne Onyankopɔn.

Monkae sɛ mewɔ mo nkyɛn no, mekaa mo yeinom anaa? Na afei, deɛ ɛsi kwan no, monim sɛ wɔbɛyi no adi ne berɛ mu. Na mmarato ahuntasɛm no anya reyɛ adwuma, nanso gye sɛ wɔayi deɛ ɔda so si kwan no afiri ntam ansa. Na ɛno ansa na wɔbɛyi deɛ ɔnni mmara biara no adie, deɛ Awurade de n’anomu home bɛkum no na ɔde ne ba no pue bɛyi no hɔ koraa no.

Ɔno nso na ne ba no, ɔba no Satan adwumayɛ soɔ, atorɔ tumi ne nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ ne ahodwirideɛ nyinaa mu, ne deɛ ɛntene nnaadaa nyinaa mu, wɔn a wɔyera no mu, ɛsiane sɛ wɔannye nokorɛ dɔ na wɔde agye wɔn nkwa no. Yei nti, Onyankopɔn soma nnaadaa a emu yɛ den aba wɔn mu ama wɔagye atorɔ adi, na wɔabu wɔn a wɔannye nokorɛ annie na mmom wɔn ani asɔ deɛ ɛntene no nyinaa atɛn.

Na yɛn deɛ, mo nti ɛsɛ sɛ yɛda Onyankopɔn ase daa, anuanom a Awurade dɔ mo, ɛfiri sɛ Onyankopɔn firi mfitiaseɛ ayi mo kɔ nkwagyeɛ mu, honhom ahoteɛ ne nokorɛ gyidie mu. Emu na ɔnam yɛn asɛmpa no so afrɛ mo aba, na moanya yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo animuonyam.

Enti afei, anuanom, monnyina pintinn, na monkura atetesɛm a yɛnam asɛm anaa yɛn nwoma so kyerɛkyerɛɛ mo no mu. Na ɔno yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo ne yɛn Agya Nyankopɔn a ɔdɔ yɛn na wama yɛn daa awerɛkyekyerɛ ne anidasoɔ pa adom mu no, ɔnkyekyere mo werɛ, na ɔnhyɛ mo den asɛm ne adwuma pa nyinaa mu.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
